remarks: Super convenient In-town flexible term furnished rental. This is an opportunity to get to know what it's like to live in the wonderful town of New Canaan CT. Walk everywhere, enjoy living in the village center, new library complex, town pool, public tennis courts, Waveny Park with gardens & walking trails, Irwin Park, Kiwanis Park, farmers market, a plethora of gourmet alfresco dining options and so much more. Private front & back entry. Sunny great room with fireplace and sitting balcony. Spacious eat in kitchen. Three ensuite bedrooms and an office. On site 2-3 parking spaces. Walking distance to Metro North NYC express train & village.
